head: CleanMyMac can now clean up your Gmail inbox and Chrome tabs
dek: MacPaw added Email Cleanup and Browser Care to CleanMyMac: delete Gmail mail in batches by sender, category, year or size and unsubscribe from several lists at once, and see which Chrome tabs use the most memory.
details: It shows how much Google storage you can win back. Deleted mail stays in Gmail's Trash for 30 days, but drafts are deleted for good. It uses your Google sign-in, which you can disconnect. Both features are free for existing CleanMyMac customers.
means: If your Gmail storage is nearly full, you can clear old promo mail in a few clicks.
todo: Update CleanMyMac and look for Email Cleanup; check before deleting drafts.
